title: No verified historical executable prices
detail: Official sportsbook quote timestamps, limits and accepted-ticker records were not obtained. Market price, price edge, betting ROI and rewards remain blank/zero. Fair model odds are not market quotes.
action: Require an authorized official operator feed or archived operator records before any betting-release claim.

title: Pilot is too small to establish skill
detail: 62 games over eight dates; 24 locked test games over three dates. The model Brier score is worse than the frozen baseline. No superiority, profitability or skill claim is supported.
action: Use a larger licensed point-in-time dataset and a genuinely prospective locked evaluation.

title: Luck cannot be removed
detail: Controls reduce leakage, selection bias and dependence errors; they cannot eliminate randomness or prove causality. Short-series confidence intervals are suppressed rather than replaced with independent-trial intervals.
action: Report uncertainty and require replication; never describe a winning streak as proof.

title: Player sample is two complete games
detail: 38 participating players across two games. Pooled cross-player correlations are not repeated within-player residual dependence. Median cohort thresholds are not personalized prop lines.
action: Obtain authorized longitudinal player logs plus pregame availability/minutes information.

title: Milwaukee published minutes sum to 240:01
detail: The 11 transcribed participating-player minute values sum to 240 minutes 1 second. Points, rebounds and assists reconcile to official team totals. No source value was silently changed.
action: Review the official box score; retain the one-second discrepancy until resolved.

title: No verified home/away or context features
detail: Scoreboard display order is retained as team1/team2. No home-court, injury, lineup, rest, travel or referee adjustment is inferred. The team1 base rate is not a league home-win rate.
action: Verify venue and point-in-time context before adding these features.

title: Same-game residual experiment is exploratory
detail: The empirical joint residual estimate beat multiplication on 24 test games, but the training sample has only 23 residual pairs. Pairwise correlation does not determine a full joint distribution or ticket value.
action: Validate joint tails, calibration and actual SGP prices on a much larger sample.

title: NBA statistics download restriction
detail: NBA FAQ says its stats are not available for academic or personal download. This workspace uses small factual extracts with links and does not operate a bulk scraper. Inherited automated collection requires rights review.
action: Use authorized access for any expanded historical collection.

title: Settlement rules are operator-specific
detail: The cited bet365 rule includes pregame overtime unless stated otherwise and has participation conditions. It cannot be generalized to every book, market or jurisdiction. No actual ticket was settled in this pilot.
action: Match each market to the operator's rules in force at acceptance, including pushes and voids.

title: Retrospective registration is not prospective preregistration
detail: Protocol and code were fixed before this pilot's evaluation, but historical data already existed. Prior researcher knowledge and concurrent experiments cannot be erased.
action: Timestamp a future protocol and freeze predictions before outcomes; record every trial.

title: Rewards are non-monetary and currently unawarded
detail: The proposed 1,000-point research pool is a scoring convention, not a funded prize. Diagnostic ranking does not qualify a betting strategy; all reward allocations are zero.
action: Award only after every gate passes and an actual reward policy is authorized.

title: Concurrent history and fixed branch constraint
detail: Main advanced repeatedly during this session. Peer work was preserved in its original namespaces. Arena requires the fixed assigned branch, so requested session-* branch naming was not used. Rebase conflicts were aborted safely and recorded.
action: Review COORDINATION.md for claims, handoffs, merge resolutions and publication records.

title: Repository scan is not universal external fact verification
detail: Every tracked text line was scanned for inventory/provenance patterns, but inherited numeric rows were not all independently re-fetched. Partner-sourced logs and known scoring discrepancies remain flagged.
action: Use the Repo Audit page for specific findings and primary-source links.

title: Some official endpoints and PDFs were unavailable
detail: NBA CDN JSON, stats API and some PDF fetches failed in the research environment. Failed fetches were not replaced with invented values or unofficial facts. Readable official HTML pages were used instead.
action: Review source availability before automating a production pipeline.
